headline: POST MALONE PUTS AUGUST 26 ON STREAMING
caption:
Post Malone's 2016 mixtape August 26 is officially available on streaming for the first time, marking the project's 10th anniversary. The 10-track tape features Larry June, 2 Chainz, Jeremih, Lil Yachty, Jaden Smith and Teo. A first official vinyl pressing is also part of the anniversary release.

Source: Post Malone official site and Spotify
https://www.postmalone.com/

Photo: The Come Up Show / CC BY 2.0
